name: Keystone Tap
description: Tap a keystone with a qi-wrapped finger to wake the stones set around it.

name: Edge Stone
description: Set a stone at each side of the body and raise a plate of force between them.

name: Spoke Tangle
description: Run lines of qi outward from one stone like spokes so that any foe among them is tangled.

name: Dust Mark
description: Sift qi dust over the ground and read which marks the passing feet have scattered.

name: Fold Array
description: Fold a small array in on itself about the body so it shields the maker and presses down on foes.

name: Pulse Ring
description: Set a ring of stones to pulse outward in turn so that each pulse pushes the foes further back.

name: Hold Frame
description: Close a frame of sealed lines about a foe's weapon hand so it cannot open or grip.

name: Wright Array
description: Lay six stones into the ground in a ring that wards the patch within and drains foes who step in.

name: Locked Matrix
description: Lock a matrix of sealed lines over a foe's footing so the foe cannot turn or leave its bounds.

name: Node Ignite
description: Light the node of an array with a pulse of qi so the lines upon it begin to glow.

name: Plate Guard
description: Slide a plate of charged stone before the body to hold a blow on its face.

name: Cord Sweep
description: Sweep a cord of qi low across the ground and snare the ankles of whoever runs at the maker.

name: Echo Stone
description: Set a stone that returns a faint echo of every footfall within a long bowshot.

name: Rune Skip
description: Skip from rune to rune on the ground with each landing sprung by the charge in the rune.

name: Keystone Burst
description: Break the keystone of a laid array so that the whole stored charge bursts outward at once.

name: Array Hold
description: Hold an array in place so that its weight presses on the qi of every foe within.

name: Mirror Plate
description: Turn a polished plate of qi to throw a bolt of qi back along the line it came.

name: Keystone Array
description: Raise an array from one keystone that rings the maker and shocks any foe who crosses its stones.

name: Pressure Matrix
description: Hold a matrix over a patch of ground that grows heavier on every foe within it each breath.

name: Paired Stone
description: Charge two stones together so that each feeds the other and both hold the charge longer.

name: Twin Plate
description: Raise two plates of force side by side so a blow that breaks one meets the other.

name: Dual Cord
description: Throw two cords from opposite hands and draw them across the foe's limbs from both sides.

name: Hawk Mark
description: Set a high mark whose sight reaches down onto the ground and shows the maker every mover below it.

name: Pair Burst
description: Burst two linked stones together so the waves of both meet in the middle of the foe.

name: Twin Clamp
description: Hold two stones at opposite sides of a foe so that the qi between them is pressed flat.

name: Twin Array
description: Lay two arrays facing each other so a foe between them is struck from both sides at once.

name: Mirrored Lattice
description: Hold two lattices as mirrors so that each takes the blows the other cannot bear.

name: Azure Node
description: Wake a pale blue node in the lattice so that it lends the maker a clean surge of qi.

name: Hawk Plate
description: Spread a broad plate of qi overhead like wings and take the blow on its flat.

name: Paired Cord
description: Pull two cords of qi taut in opposite directions across the foe's arms.

name: Flow Stone
description: Set a stone that shows the current of qi in the lattice and where it is turned aside.

name: Twin Step
description: Step from one node of a pair to its twin with the charge between them carrying the stride.

name: Azure Pin
description: Cast a pin of pale blue qi from a node so it pierces the guard and sticks in the target.

name: Pair Flare
description: Flare two nodes in the same breath so a bright crossing wave sweeps the ground between them.

name: Pair Seal
description: Seal a pair of nodes so the foe cannot cross between them and the maker is screened.

name: Mirror Hold
description: Hold a foe with matched cords from either side and press down on the qi in the middle.

name: Azure Array
description: Raise a lattice of pale blue stones that binds foes within it and lets the maker pass unharmed.

name: Clear Lattice
description: Hold a lattice over an ally that draws poison and taint out of the body and screens the ally from blows.

name: Oath Stone
description: Press a sworn stone to the breast and let it return a measure of steady qi.

name: Heading Thread
description: Draw a line of qi toward the wind and read from it the heading of whatever crosses it.

name: Breeze Cord
description: Cast a cord of qi on the wind so it drifts out and wraps the foe's leading arm.

name: Ajar Ward
description: Hold a ward open at one side so that a blow slips along it and away.

name: Breeze Anchor
description: Cast anchors that burst into a gust where they land and drag the foes' feet together.

name: Sworn Ring
description: Draw a ring about oneself that holds against blows and lends back a measure of the maker's qi.

name: Drift Mark
description: Cast a drifting mark onto a foe's sign so that it slides out of true and fails.

name: Bearing Array
description: Lay an array of open stones that turn foes off their heading and leave a clear path for the maker.

name: Wind Lattice
description: Hold a lattice whose open cells let the wind through and turn each blow aside along its lines.

name: Sworn Stone
description: Press a stone sworn to the maker and draw a steady charge of qi from it.

name: Wind Plate
description: Set a plate of qi against the wind of a blow so that the force spreads and thins.

name: Gale Cord
description: Whip a cord of qi on a hard gust around a foe and hold it as the wind strains.

name: Heading Glyph
description: Etch a glyph that turns to point at the nearest body and shows how fast it comes.

name: Slip Mark
description: Leave a mark behind and slip sideways onto its twin so the foe's blow meets only the first.

name: Oath Burst
description: Break a sworn mark and let its stored qi leap outward as a hard flat gust.

name: Crosswind Hold
description: Cross two lines of qi over a foe so that its own qi is pushed back on itself.

name: Course Seal
description: Seal a foe's heading with a mark so that every step it takes returns to the same spot.

name: Oath Array
description: Lay an array sworn to the maker that will not break while the oath stands.

name: Sworn Matrix
description: Hold a matrix of sworn lines that presses on the qi of every foe who has broken faith with it.
